## recipe-280 — Refined Stone Backpack
**REVIEWED — authored operational PLAYTEST.** public; Leatherworking level 4; tier 2; Common; DC 9. Standard quantity 4; source Standard batch reference 178 gp.
**Preserved effect:** Creates a reinforced backpack carrying 10 pounds without counting against normal encumbrance; grants +1 to checks to secure or retrieve its contents.

**Operational effect:** One output transforms one complete mundane body, retaining its physical identity and latest lawful completion damage state. Functional means at least 1 current structural HP; the singleton Flawed result can emerge Broken with a dormant imprint. While functional, unsuppressed, unmelded, properly fitted and worn or directly held in its recorded back-cargo relief position, cover up to 10 lb of eligible contents in stable loading order. Physical capacity remains 30 lb and 1 ft³, subject to its actual opening, shape and compartment limits. Its own body is not relieved. For each covered record, subtract covered pounds from the direct bearer's pound-carrying comparison and at most min(canonical Load, covered pounds/10) from Inventory Load; preserve actual mass and canonical Load. Enclosed enchanted containers are inactive; ordinary inner bodies and descendants count once. External lashings do not become contents. The actual operator receives +1 on a qualifying handling check: Actual difficult cargo handling to secure its ordinary closure/retainers or retrieve through an unlocked closure, jam, tangle or other physical difficulty: DEX for dexterous work or STR (Athletics) for forceful handling of noncreature cargo. This handling benefit needs accessible functional unsuppressed fittings, not a relief slot, and can apply on a table or for an ally. Only the strongest qualifying Leatherworking task bonus applies once per actual check. No routine check is invented; ordinary actions, hands, access, proficiency and competing slot requirements still apply. Broken stops positive functions; suppression stops recipe magic, not physical capacity or workmanship. Use the complete shared guide for custody, melding, quality, repair and value.
**Legal mundane bases:** Backpack. One model, actual fit and legal grade for the whole batch. Buy, own or legitimately commission complete bodies; no stock-construction recipe is implied.

**Physical reserve:** 6 complete, nonmagical, non-Broken bases in a stable physical-ID order before work; containers empty. No existing imprint. Missing/Broken/committed bases pause before the roll; repair or replace at the same position. Transform the first resolved N, using latest lawful completion HP. Keep unused bodies in their actual state outside ingredient recovery.
